sloka: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा हनूमता ऽक्षे निहते कुमारे ।मनः समाधाय तदेन्द्रकल्पं समादिदेशेन्द्रजितं सरोषम् ।। ५.४८.१।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa rakṣodhipatirmahātmā hanūmatā 'kṣe nihate kumāre ।manaḥ samādhāya tadendrakalpaṁ samādideśendrajitaṁ saroṣam ।। 5.48.1।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the great demon king, mighty angry at the death of Aksha in the hands of Hanuman, controlled his feeling and ordered Indrajit who was like a godhead.
translations.hindi: महावीर हनुमानजी के, उन वचनों को सुन, रावण ने क्रुद्ध हो, उनके मारे जाने की प्राज्ञा दी
